from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_COLOR_INDEX
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
import re

def new_doc(font="Calibri", size=11):
    d = Document()
    for s in d.sections:
        s.page_width = Inches(8.5); s.page_height = Inches(11)
        s.left_margin = s.right_margin = Inches(1)
        s.top_margin = s.bottom_margin = Inches(0.9)
    st = d.styles["Normal"]; st.font.name = font; st.font.size = Pt(size)
    st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), font)
    st.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)
    st.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.08
    for h in ("Heading 1","Heading 2","Heading 3"):
        hs = d.styles[h]; hs.font.name = font; hs.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x1F,0x3A,0x5F)
        hs.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), font)
    d.styles["Heading 1"].font.size = Pt(13)
    d.styles["Heading 2"].font.size = Pt(12)
    d.styles["Heading 3"].font.size = Pt(11)
    return d

TOKEN = re.compile(r"(\*\*.+?\*\*|\[\[.+?\]\]|__.+?__)")
def add_runs(p, text, size=None):
    """**bold**, [[drafting note -> highlighted bracket]], __italic__"""
    for part in TOKEN.split(text):
        if not part: continue
        if part.startswith("**"):
            r = p.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.bold = True
        elif part.startswith("[["):
            r = p.add_run("[" + part[2:-2] + "]"); r.font.highlight_color = WD_COLOR_INDEX.YELLOW
        elif part.startswith("__"):
            r = p.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.italic = True
        else:
            r = p.add_run(part)
        if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
    return p

def para(d, text="", style=None, align=None, after=None, size=None, before=None):
    p = d.add_paragraph(style=style) if style else d.add_paragraph()
    add_runs(p, text, size)
    if align: p.alignment = align
    if after is not None: p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(after)
    if before is not None: p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(before)
    return p

def bullet(d, text, level=0, size=None):
    p = d.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet" if level == 0 else "List Bullet 2")
    add_runs(p, text, size); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
    return p

def number(d, text):
    p = d.add_paragraph(style="List Number"); add_runs(p, text); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3); return p

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr(); sh = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    sh.set(qn("w:val"),"clear"); sh.set(qn("w:color"),"auto"); sh.set(qn("w:fill"),hexcolor); tcPr.append(sh)

def table(d, rows, widths, header=True, size=9.5):
    t = d.add_table(rows=len(rows), cols=len(rows[0])); t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i, row in enumerate(rows):
        for j, val in enumerate(row):
            c = t.cell(i, j); c.width = widths[j]
            c.paragraphs[0].text = ""
            lines = val.split("\n")
            for k, line in enumerate(lines):
                p = c.paragraphs[0] if k == 0 else c.add_paragraph()
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
                add_runs(p, line, size)
                if header and i == 0:
                    for r in p.runs: r.bold = True
            if header and i == 0: shade(c, "D9E2F3")
    # grid widths
    grid = t._tbl.tblGrid
    for j, gc in enumerate(grid.findall(qn("w:gridCol"))):
        gc.set(qn("w:w"), str(int(widths[j].inches*1440)))
    return t

def header_footer(d, header_text, footer_text):
    s = d.sections[0]
    hp = s.header.paragraphs[0]; hp.text = ""; r = hp.add_run(header_text); r.font.size = Pt(8); r.bold = True
    r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xC0,0x00,0x00); hp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    fp = s.footer.paragraphs[0]; fp.text = ""; fp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    r = fp.add_run(footer_text + "  |  Page "); r.font.size = Pt(8)
    for code in ("PAGE",):
        r2 = fp.add_run(); r2.font.size = Pt(8)
        b = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); b.set(qn("w:fldCharType"),"begin")
        it = OxmlElement("w:instrText"); it.set(qn("xml:space"),"preserve"); it.text = code
        e = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); e.set(qn("w:fldCharType"),"end")
        r2._r.append(b); r2._r.append(it); r2._r.append(e)
EOF
